q: Luminous flux (luminous power) Φ is measured in ____. (2024)
e: Luminous flux measures the total perceived power of light, and its SI unit is the lumen (lm).

q: An aperture is a circular opening through which the ____ passes. (2024)
e: In optical systems like cameras or eyes, light passes through the circular aperture opening.

q: Human eye is more sensitive to ____ light compared to other colors. (2025)
e: The human eye's photoreceptor cells are most sensitive to green light in the visible spectrum.

q: A camera is an ____ instrument that records an image of an object. (2025)
e: A camera uses optical components like lenses to focus light and form images.

q: The pupil automatically dilates in dim light and ____ in bright light. (2026)
e: The iris contracts the pupil size in bright light to protect the retina from excessive light.

q: The lens in a compound microscope nearer the object is called the ____. (2026)
e: In a compound microscope, the lens positioned closest to the object being observed is the objective lens.

q: In the terrestrial telescope a ____ lens is used as an eyepiece to produce an erect final image. (2026)
e: A terrestrial telescope can use a concave eyepiece lens to invert the image back upright.

q: As the magnifying power increases, the ____ of images is reduced. (2025)
e: Increasing optical magnification generally reduces image brightness and sharpness.

q: The fibre optics works on the principle of ____. (2025)
e: Optical fibers guide light signals along their core using total internal reflection.

q: The ____ is the coloured portion of the eye and controls the amount of light entering the eye. (2025)
e: The iris is the pigmented circular muscular diaphragm that controls light entry into the eye.

q: The ____ in the eye is similar to the aperture in the camera. (2026)
e: The pupil acts as the physical opening for light entry in the eye, functioning like a camera aperture.

q: ____ light means that it has a single wavelength. (2025)
e: Monochromatic light consists of light waves of a single pure wavelength or frequency.

q: The component of a camera that regulates the amount of light entering is known as the ____. (2026)
e: The aperture regulates the amount of light passing through the camera lens.

q: The film consists of a thin layer of chemical compounds of ____. (2025)
e: Photographic film utilizes silver halide light-sensitive chemical emulsions.

q: One of the unique properties of a laser beam is ____. (2026)
c: coherence (or) monochromatic (or) narrow beam of intense
e: Laser light features spatial and temporal coherence, monochromaticity, and high directional intensity.

q: The SI unit for illuminance is lux (lx), 1 lx is equal to ____ lm m⁻². (2025)
e: By definition, one lux is equal to one lumen per square meter.

q: A camera is an ____ instrument that records an image of an object. (2025)
e: An optical device relies on optical principles to capture and form images.

q: The shutter ____ is expressed in terms of the exposure time. (2025)
e: Shutter speed quantifies the duration during which light is allowed to hit the photographic sensor or film.

q: The ____ is a circular opening through which the light passes. (2025)
e: An aperture is the circular opening that lets light travel through an optical system.

q: Illuminance Eₒ is the total ____ incident on a surface per unit area. (2025)
e: Illuminance is defined as the total luminous flux incident per unit area of a surface.

q: The aperture can be made wide or narrow by adjusting the ____. (2026)
e: The diaphragm is the mechanical mechanism that adjusts the size of the aperture.

q: The human eye responds only to light having wavelengths between about 400 nm and ____. (2026)
e: The human visible spectrum ranges from approximately 400 nm (violet) to 700 nm (red).

q: The compound microscope has at least ____ convex lenses. (2026)
e: A compound microscope consists of at least two convex lens systems: objective and eyepiece.

q: People with normal vision can see clearly objects which are at ____. (2026)
e: The far point of a human eye with normal vision is situated at infinity.
